gen-press-start-2p-gf-geom: Chunky pixel fun up top, with Press Start 2P spacing its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart. And Geom is the grounded half, a contemporary sans-serif whose lofty lowercase gives the whole pair its footing.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hammersmith-one: Pixel-bright and playful, Press Start 2P swells slightly on its bowls while Hammersmith One stays flat. But the real strength is that body, a sans-serif of rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-inder: Inder reads clean and professional, its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Press Start 2P is the one for retro fun with a faint gradient along each curve, while Inder simply keeps the text moving.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-jaldi: Jaldi sets a sans with a lofty x-height and a visibly gaping c, its letters brushed on with barely a gap. Press Start 2P does the loud, playful work.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Far-apart letters, like cut-outs pinned in a row, define Press Start 2P. Kdam Thmor Pro follows with modern sans bowls that fill the line, so a longer passage moves along with a dense, contemporary texture.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-magra: Magra brings a big-bodied feel to every lowercase word, a professional sans with no fuss. Magra holds the text while Press Start 2P earns its keep big and short, with a tempered contrast like flexed spring wire.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-major-mono-display: Major Mono Display reads like neon glass, a precise monospace with large sidebearings and curves that sweep open. Major Mono Display is the wire-bent counterpart to Press Start 2P, whose weight shifts gradually instead of snapping.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-martian-mono: Martian Mono lays out fixed-width, code-style letters with generous openings in every curve. Martian Mono is the spaghetti-straight monospace half, while Press Start 2P does its best with a mid-range gap between its boldest and faintest strokes.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-matemasie: Matemasie reads clean and professional, with broad gaps between glyphs and tiny entry points into its round letters. Yet the strongest quality is how that plain sans lets Press Start 2P stay playful.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-menbere: Clean and neutral, Menbere stacks its lowercase tall like rolled cord, a plain sans with quiet manners. And Press Start 2P, with heavier verticals like a gently tilted nib, lends the page a retro grin as the paragraphs run on.
